name: MEHUL AGARWAL
summary: Product manager who builds the systems that connect demand to supply, and now owns the business outcome they produce. 4+ years across digital product, growth, and partnerships -- 3+ of them in consumer lending at Bajaj Finance, India's largest retail NBFC. Started on the platform side, owning the Personal Loan application journey through the channel's scale-up from ~₹400 Cr to ~₹1,100 Cr in monthly disbursals. Now on the business side of the mortgage portfolio, carrying the ~₹100 Cr/month disbursal number against a ~₹1,500 Cr annual mandate and running a matching engine that qualifies ~90,000 leads/month against credit criteria and routes them across a 9-partner network. Work where product, commercial, and partnerships meet, with a ~20-member cross-functional pod across 10 functions.

skills.label: Product & Delivery
skills.items: Product Management, Product Lifecycle Management, Product Strategy, Roadmapping, Requirement Gathering, BRDs/PRDs, Agile/Scrum, UX Design (Figma)

skills.label: Business, Growth & Partnerships
skills.items: Strategic Partnerships & Alliances, Funnel & Conversion Optimisation, Stakeholder Management, Customer Journey Mapping, Go-to-Market Strategy, Process Automation, Team Leadership

skills.label: Domain -- Lending & Credit
skills.items: Digital Lending, NBFC/FinTech, Business Rules Engines (BRE), Lead Allocation & Distribution, Lending-Partner Integrations, Straight-Through Processing

skills.label: Data & Tools
skills.items: SQL, Google Analytics, CleverTap, Looker Studio, A/B Testing, MS Excel, Azure DevOps, Google/Meta Ads, SEO

roles.title: Product Manager - Home Loans: Digital Growth & Lending Partnerships
bullets: Own the business side of digital acquisition for the mortgage portfolio (Home Loans, LAP, Balance Transfer, Top-up), carrying the disbursal number for an online channel at ~₹100 Cr/month (~₹1,200 Cr annualised), up from ~₹80 Cr, against a full-year mandate of ~₹1,500 Cr.

Designed and shipped the MCP (Minimum Credit Parameters) Master and Lead Allocation Master -- a two-sided matching engine that scores ~90,000 leads/month against each partner's credit criteria and routes every lead to its best-fit lender, lifting lead-to-login conversion 40% and lead-to-disbursal from 0.5% to 0.7% at a ~40% approval rate and 50% match rate.

Grew the live partner network from 4 to 6 lenders (2 more in build), negotiating lead-exchange and commission economics with Legal, Business, and Technology so a single customer can be matched against multiple partners' criteria and monetised through distribution.

Made the call to optimise for qualified demand over raw lead volume, accepting lower lead counts -- feeding qualification outcomes back into campaign targeting to cut cost per lead 33%, from ~₹1,350 to ~₹900.

Built a lead-reassignment model that re-routes customers declined by their first partner to the next-best match on the priority list, recovering demand that would otherwise be lost and raising overall utilisation of every lead acquired.

Part of a ~20-member cross-functional pod (product, engineering, growth, CX, analytics) with 2 direct reports, aligning 10 functions -- Business, Sales, Call Centre, Credit Policy, Risk, Legal, Compliance, IT, CX, and Marketing.

Define the capability roadmap and requirements for the channel as its business owner -- translating the disbursal target into product, policy, and partner asks for Technology, Credit, and Legal to build against.

projects.name: Next Best Product Engine (In Progress)
projects.desc: Building a cross-sell framework that checks eligibility across adjacent products when a customer fails the primary product's criteria, using a propensity model to surface the top 3 relevant offers inside the same journey -- converting declined applicants into retained demand instead of lost traffic.

roles.title: Product Manager - Personal Loans: Digital Platform
bullets: Owned the Personal Loan digital platform (app and web) at ~15 lakh Form-1 submissions/month, turning business and credit requirements into shipped capability while the channel scaled from ~₹400 Cr to ~₹1,100 Cr in monthly disbursals through a period of sector-wide tightening in consumer credit.

Rebuilt the application journey with UI/UX -- cutting drop-off 40% and completion time 15%, lifting completed applications 30% and automating 22% more of the journey end-to-end through straight-through processing.

Lifted conversion 23% and user acquisition 14% by instrumenting the journey in Google Analytics and CleverTap, isolating the cohorts that dropped, and sequencing fixes by revenue impact rather than ticket count.

Ran the full product lifecycle for platform releases -- requirement intake, PRDs, design, build, QA, deployment, and post-launch iteration -- as the primary interface between business stakeholders and Engineering on scope, trade-offs, and release status.

projects.name: GYDE AI Voice Assist
projects.desc: Shipped conversational voice assistance inside the application form to guide applicants through completion, lifting Form-1 submissions ~3.5% -- roughly 50,000 additional submissions per month at platform scale.

projects.name: Microfinance Loans -- 0 to 1 Digital Journey
projects.desc: Launched digital lead creation for Microfinance group loans on app and web from scratch, generating ~2,000 leads/month and opening an underserved customer segment to digital origination.

roles.title: Digital Marketing Associate
bullets: Ran paid acquisition end-to-end -- restructuring Meta (Facebook and Instagram) campaigns across copy, targeting, and budget allocation to cut cost-per-click 58% and improve return on ad spend 35%.

Raised the website's SEO score from 34 to 51 through on-page and off-page optimisation, driving a 22% increase in organic traffic, and built content calendars with design partners that lifted click-through rates 15%.

roles.title: Product Marketing Intern
bullets: Built the go-to-market strategy for a packaged-foods launch and ran the pre-launch campaign across creatives, landing page, and budget allocation.
Ran market research and competitive pricing analysis for the client's cloud-kitchen operations, identifying the locations with highest revenue potential.
